instruction: A mass-produced running sneaker with a layered foam midsole and rubber outsole, a fabric mesh upper, a padded tongue, a heel counter, and several lace loops (eyelets) with laces. Realistic left-shoe proportions.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a running sneaker. A mass-produced running sneaker with a layered foam midsole and rubber outsole, a fabric mesh upper, a padded tongue, a heel counter, and several lace loops (eyelets) with laces. Realistic left-shoe proportions. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
